Help.title: Help
Help.intro: AnyGet saves public files from many sites to this computer. Here is how to use it.

paste.title: Paste a link
paste.text: Paste one or many links on Home and press Check link. The preview shows what is behind the link: formats for videos, files for repositories and web pages, pages for library items. Pick what you want and press Download.

sources.title: Sources
sources.text: Pages for YouTube and video sites, archive.org, the Wayback Machine, code hosts, image galleries, books and libraries help you find things. Search everything searches books, libraries, archive.org and videos at once.

library.title: Library
library.text: Every finished download is listed in the Library with a preview. Tag files, find copies of the same file, and remove what you do not need.

watch.title: Watches
watch.text: Add a channel, playlist or archive.org collection on the Watches page. AnyGet checks it on schedule and downloads only new items.

convert.title: Convert
convert.text: Finished files can be converted from Downloads: make a scanned PDF searchable (OCR), merge page images into a PDF, or save audio as MP3.

cli.title: Command line
cli.text: Run anyget get LINK in a terminal to download without the website, anyget search "title" to find books, and anyget watch-clipboard to offer every link you copy.

remote.title: From your phone
remote.text: AnyGet runs on your computer. To use it from anywhere, put it behind Cloudflare Access or Tailscale (see the deploy guide).

submit.text: Check the links in the paste box

Help.legalLink: Read the legal and fair use rules
Help.playbackText: Audio plays in a small player at the bottom of the screen and keeps playing while you move between AnyGet's pages. On phones, playback can also continue with the screen locked or in another app where the browser allows it: Android Chrome usually does; iPhone Safari usually does in a Safari tab, and less reliably for the app added to the Home Screen. AnyGet doesn't use tricks to keep audio alive, so your phone's battery settings may stop it.
Help.retentionText: By default, downloaded files are kept forever. In Settings → Downloads you can have them removed after a number of days; the first removals happen that many days after you switch it on. Files tagged “keep”, and downloads still running, are never removed. The Library keeps an entry for each removed file with Download again.

Legal.title: Legal and fair use
Legal.intro: AnyGet is free, open-source software. These rules are built in and cannot be turned off.

personal.title: Personal use
personal.text: Download only what you own, what is public domain or openly licensed, or what the site allows you to download.

drm.title: No DRM
drm.text: DRM-protected content (paid streaming, music services, paid ebooks) is never downloaded.

shadow.title: No shadow libraries
shadow.text: Pirate book sites such as LibGen, Z-Library or Anna's Archive are never used as sources.

bypass.title: No bypassing
bypass.text: Region blocks, lending and borrow limits, paywalls and members-only content are respected. AnyGet shows a clear message instead.

copyright.title: Books in copyright
copyright.text: Books still in copyright are shown as not legally downloadable, with links to borrow or buy them.

cookies.title: Your own accounts only
cookies.text: A cookies.txt file may only come from accounts you are legally signed in to. It stays on this computer.

etiquette.title: Be a good guest
etiquette.text: AnyGet limits parallel downloads per site, backs off when a site asks it to slow down, and identifies itself honestly.

disclaimer.personal: AnyGet is for personal use. Download only what you own, what is public domain or openly licensed, or what the site's terms allow.
disclaimer.never: It does not and will not remove DRM, get around paywalls, logins, region blocks or lending limits, or use shadow libraries.
disclaimer.responsible: You are responsible for what you download, and for following the law where you live and each site's terms.
disclaimer.warranty: AnyGet is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. See the <link>MIT License</link>.
disclaimer.trademarks: The authors are not affiliated with any site AnyGet can download from. All trademarks belong to their owners.

Share.title: Nothing to download
Share.noLink: The shared text has no link in it. Share a web page or a link to a file.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.subtitle: AnyGet is private. Only its owner can sign in.
Login.limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
Login.noOwner: No sign-in is set up yet. Set ANYGET_OWNER_EMAIL and ANYGET_OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH (make the hash with anyget hash-password), then restart the API.
Login.network: AnyGet could not be reached. Try again.
Login.setupText: This AnyGet can be reached from the internet, so it refuses every request until an owner is set. On the computer or server that runs the API:
Login.setupHash: Make a password hash (the password needs at least 10 characters):
Login.setupHashSource: or, when you run AnyGet from source:
Login.setupVars: Set these variables for the API. The session secret is any long random string; in a .env file used by Docker Compose, write each $ of the hash as $$.
Login.setupRestart: Restart the API, then reload this page and sign in.

Connections.title: Connections
Connections.subtitle: Connect your own accounts and keys. AnyGet then downloads what you can see when signed in. It never gets around paywalls, DRM, members-only content or region blocks.
Connections.keyFile: Saved connections are encrypted with a key kept in the data folder. For more safety, set ANYGET_SECRETS_KEY on the server (make one with anyget gen-key).
Connections.importHelp: Export a cookies.txt file from your browser while you are signed in, then add it here. AnyGet keeps only the cookies of the sites below and encrypts them.
Connections.howTitle: How to get a cookies.txt file
Connections.how1: Install a cookies.txt exporter in your browser, such as “Get cookies.txt LOCALLY” (Chrome or Firefox).
Connections.how2: Sign in to the site with your own account.
Connections.how3: Open the extension on that site and export cookies.txt (Netscape format).
Connections.how4: Add the file here. Don't share it: it works like your password.
Connections.keysHelp: Free keys and tokens raise limits and unlock sources. They are saved encrypted and never shown again.

Sections.title: Sections
Sections.subtitle: Browse by kind of thing: films, books, music, video, declassified files, maps, newspapers, photos and manuscripts. Each has ready-made searches.
Sections.tmdbHint: Add a free TMDB key in Connections to see where films stream in India.

movies.title: Movies
movies.text: Where to watch legally, plus public-domain classics to download.
movies.hero: Find where a film streams in India (Netflix, Prime Video, JioHotstar, Zee5, SonyLIV…), rent or buy it, or download public-domain classics from archive.org. No piracy, ever.

books.title: Books
books.text: The best legal copy from Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks, Open Library and libraries.
books.hero: Free books from Project Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks, Open Library, archive.org and national libraries, with the best legal copy on top.

music.title: Music
music.text: Public-domain recordings, 78rpm records and old radio.
music.hero: Public-domain and openly licensed recordings: the Great 78 Project, archive.org audio, old radio shows and more.

video.title: Video
video.text: Documentaries, NASA footage, lectures and newsreels.
video.hero: Documentaries, NASA footage, lectures, newsreels and Creative Commons video, plus any link yt-dlp supports.

declassified.title: Declassified
declassified.hero: Officially released records from the CIA Reading Room, FBI Vault, US and UK National Archives, MuckRock and The Black Vault. Only documents that were made public.

more.title: More
more.text: Maps, newspapers, photos, manuscripts, code and web archives.
more.hero: Maps, newspapers, photos and manuscripts, plus archive.org, the Wayback Machine, code and image galleries.

maps.title: Maps
maps.text: Historic maps from libraries and archives.
maps.hero: Historic maps from the Library of Congress, David Rumsey, Old Maps Online and archives.

newspapers.title: Newspapers
newspapers.hero: Historic newspapers from Chronicling America, Trove and other archives.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hero: Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, library collections and Flickr Commons, each with its licence.

manuscripts.title: Manuscripts
manuscripts.hero: Manuscripts from national libraries through IIIF, downloadable page by page or as a PDF.
